title: Investigating Protein Ubiquitination and Localization in Response to Nitrogen Deficiency
summary: This cluster focuses on the process of protein ubiquitination and its relation to various cellular processes. Researchers Furukawa M and Riffle M et al. have used methods to target protein ubiquitination, while Mendes used methods to study nitrogen deficiency and signature genes. The BTB-Cullin complex mediates protein ubiquitination. Additionally, Riffle M et al. and Tkach JM have used methods to study Dissecting DNA, abundance changes, damage response, and protein localization.
